counting.human_checkpoint: One selected human:guided or human:confirm checklist step.
counting.paid_operation: One intentionally requested subject-under-test model completion named by a paid-operations annotation.
counting.panel: Count every worker completion and every prompted managed-session turn.
counting.multi_round: Count every worker completion in every round.
counting.managed_session: Count every prompted turn; launch and exit without a prompt counts zero.
counting.codex_verify_enrollment: Count one only when the empirical probe turn runs.
counting.ai_curated_transfer: Count one when external curation runs; deterministic fallback counts zero.
counting.driver: Exclude the Claude-hosted checklist driver's orchestration and report it separately.

duration.over_threshold: Set budget_review_required=true and require maintainer disposition; do not alter correctness.
